comment: The render pipelines -pipeline names: a short name and its asset class (a script class below RenderPipelineAsset of a linked module; empty: no pipeline). Any asset class name works on the command line too.
companions_comment: Components a pipeline puts beside others the editor adds (and beside a new scene's), by class: of, the component; add, its companion; defaults, the companion's properties set when the component's properties are as in when.
